title: CuCrZr LPBF as-built conductivity
finding: As-built CuCrZr retained moderate conductivity but requires aging for target values

title: CuCrZr solution treated conductivity
finding: Solution treatment improved conductivity but aging coverage is still missing

title: 316L LPBF density after HIP
finding: HIP closed residual porosity and raised density above 99 percent

title: 316L surface finish after HIP
finding: HIP did not solve surface roughness without machining or blasting
